name: Forno Acqua MultiSINK Stainless Steel 45" Dual Mount 3-Level Workstation Sink with 2 Faucets and Glass Rinser
shortDescription: Transform your kitchen into a multitasking powerhouse with the MultiSINK ProChef45XL Workstation. This all-in-one solution features three functional levels for seamless prep, rinse, and dry, plus custom-fit accessories that elevate every task. The integrated pivoting WaterWALL rinse zone delivers effortless cleaning from any angle, while the powerful glass washer ensures spotless drinkware every time. On-deck drying stations maximize space and efficiency, and dual 3-function Chef faucets are built for two users with boost-blade cleaning power. Dual-mount installation and IAPMO certification ensure lasting quality and universal fit. Complete with a sliding sink, bamboo cutting board, colander, and four heavy-duty roll-up grids, this workstation is designed for serious cooks, shared kitchens, and stunning island installations.
